title: ConnectorCapabilities
description: What one connector instance can do. The five capabilities are INDEPENDENT: no capability implies another. In particular, notification access gives at most `read` (and only reply-via-RemoteInput where actually tested gives `send`); it never implies `send` or `swipe`. Callers (the dispatcher, the Android UI) must check the specific capability they need. `UNSUPPORTED` operations must return a typed unsupported result, never silently succeed. Autopilot sends require `send.status == VERIFIED`; `UNVERIFIED` send is allowed only through explicit user approval. See docs/adr/0005-connector-capability-model.md. Since contract 1.3.0 an optional sixth capability, `profile_read` (can read dating profiles for review, WING-019/031), may be stated; absent means UNSUPPORTED. It is independent of `read` (messages) and of `swipe`. There is no BLOCKED label: a capability blocked by an external dependency is UNVERIFIED (implemented, not reproduced) or UNSUPPORTED (not available), with the blocker in `notes` (ADR 0008).

connector_version.description: Version of the connector implementation that made this assessment.

read.description: Can observe inbound messages and/or read conversation history.

draft.description: Can place a draft into the platform's compose field for the user to send by hand. Wingman-internal drafts (the approval queue) do not need this capability.

send.description: Can transmit an outbound message and report an acknowledgement.

swipe.description: Can like/pass profiles. Only `requestProfileActionExecution` (contract 1.3.0) uses it, and only when VERIFIED (ADR 0008).

calendar_write.description: Can create calendar events (WING-018). Still requires user authorization per event unless opted in.

profile_read.description: (1.3.0, optional) Can read dating profiles (bio, prompts, provided attributes) for the review queue. Independent of `read` and `swipe`. Absent means UNSUPPORTED.

verification.description: VERIFIED: reproduced on a real device/account and evidence recorded. UNVERIFIED: implemented or plausible but not reproduced; must not be used for autopilot. UNSUPPORTED: not available; calls must fail with a typed unsupported result.

evidence.description: Where the verification is recorded (doc path, test ID, device log reference). Required when VERIFIED.

verified_at.description: When the capability was last verified. Required when VERIFIED.

reports_delivery_receipts.description: Only meaningful for `send`: true if the transport reports delivery (enables the `delivered` state). Absent/false means messages stop at `sent`.
